environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/MigrationToolRole with condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID=o-abc123def4. No additional invoke permissions exist. The Function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} for any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from an authorized IAM principal. Note: the code itself performs no authentication checks — it relies entirely on the Function URL IAM auth layer to reject unauthorized callers before the handler executes.
